settings.hero_sub: Made with grass-fed gelatin, real fruit and full research‑backed doses. No seed oils, nothing artificial.

settings.pot_body:
Most gummies are made like candy. The base is glucose syrup and sugar, set with pectin or starch, and the actives get whatever room is left. When labs test them, the dose often doesn’t match the label.

We use real ingredients. Real fruit, research‑backed actives at the doses used in human studies, and every amount printed on the label. No seed oils, nothing artificial.

We use 100% grass‑fed beef gelatin, while others use pectin or starch. Classic pectin won’t set unless the mix is more than 55% sugar and other dissolved solids. Gelatin sets on its own, it’s over 92% protein, and it gives every gummy a dense, clean chew that melts in your mouth.
settings.pot_i1_text: Not pectin or starch. A protein base that sets without a sugar-heavy mix.
settings.pot_i2_text: No seed oils, no artificial colors, flavors or sweeteners.
settings.pot_i3_text: Every active at the dose used in human research, printed on the label and tested in the finished product.
settings.pot_why: In a 2023 JAMA study, 22 of 25 melatonin gummies didn’t match their label, with actual doses from 74% to 347% of the amount stated. In 2024, NOW tested 12 creatine gummy brands and 6 failed to meet their label claim.
settings.pot_source: Cohen et al., JAMA, 2023; NOW, February 2024.

settings.rd_body: Reserve pairs 100% grass-fed beef gelatin with well-supported cognitive ingredients, including Magtein®, citicoline, L-theanine and B vitamins. The result is a premium gummy built for taste, texture and a cleaner daily ritual.
settings.rd_f1_text: Just a smooth, premium gummy with a clean finish.
settings.rd_f2_text: Magtein®, citicoline, L-theanine and B vitamins, thoughtfully combined.
settings.rd_f3_text: 100% grass-fed beef gelatin, chosen to support the formula and the experience.
